newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WTO elects Brazilian as General Council chair.
newsitem.headline: WTO elects Brazilian as General Council chair.

text.p: Brazil's ambassador Celso Lafer was elected chairman on Friday of the World Trade Organisation's ruling General Council for 1997, the 130-member watchdog said.
Trade envoys also chose chairpersons of 10 other WTO bodies, including New Zealand envoy Wade Armstrong as head of the Dispute Settlement Body, WTO said in a statement after closed-door talks.

But trade delegates failed to appoint chairman for three working groups -- on investment, competition and transparency in government procurement practices -- which are to follow up on the Singapore ministerial conference last December.
Lafer will hold consultations and decide whether to bring the matter to the General Council, according to trade sources.
"Clearly there was strong support for bringing selection of the three officials to the General Council," one source said.
